report.summary: Reviewed daedalus/adapters/events.py chunk 1/1: dataclasses, event union, TransportRecord, event_to_transport_record. All docstring claims kept; no defects found.

handoff.purpose: Define event dataclasses and lossless transport record conversion.

symbols.name: AgentCapabilities
symbols.note: Dataclass with streaming, resume, hidden_state_access booleans; not part of AgentEvent union.

symbols.name: SessionEnded
symbols.note: Dataclass with session_id, exit_code, stderr default empty.

symbols.name: ToolRequested
symbols.note: Dataclass with tool_name, arguments dict, call_id.

symbols.name: ToolCompleted
symbols.note: Dataclass with call_id, result, is_error flag.

symbols.name: AgentMessage
symbols.note: Dataclass with content and role default 'assistant'.

symbols.name: AgentEvent
symbols.note: Union type covering all event dataclasses except AgentCapabilities.

symbols.name: _CAMEL_BOUNDARY
symbols.note: Regex for camelCase to snake_case conversion: matches uppercase letters not at start.

symbols.name: TransportRecord
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for lossless envelope; includes to_dict, from_dict, embedding_text.

symbols.name: TransportRecord.to_dict
symbols.note: Returns asdict(self); may fail if payload contains non-serializable objects.

symbols.name: TransportRecord.from_dict
symbols.note: Classmethod reconstructs TransportRecord from dict; uses str() on required fields and defaults for optional.

symbols.name: TransportRecord.embedding_text
symbols.note: Returns a stable text projection using runtime/direction/event_type and content.

symbols.name: event_to_transport_record
symbols.note: Converts an AgentEvent to TransportRecord; validates direction; constructs content based on event type.

claims.text: Lossless envelope exchanged between a runtime shell and downstream sinks.
claims.why: TransportRecord stores all original event fields in payload and preserves them via asdict; content is derived but payload retains the original event data, so the envelope is lossless regarding the typed event.

claims.text: Embeddings are derived from this record; they never replace its original payload or provenance.
claims.why: embedding_text only computes a string projection; it does not mutate the record or replace payload/metadata. The original payload and metadata remain intact.

claims.text: Stable text projection used by an optional embedding index.
claims.why: The method returns a deterministic string based on runtime, direction, event_type, and content. It is stable for the same inputs.

claims.text: Wrap one typed event without discarding its provider-neutral payload.
claims.why: The function creates a TransportRecord with payload set to asdict(event), preserving the full typed event data. No discarding occurs.

claims.text: direction must be input, output, or system
claims.why: The code explicitly raises ValueError if direction is not in the set {'input', 'output', 'system'}, enforcing the stated constraint.

observations.what: AgentCapabilities is defined but not included in AgentEvent union; likely used elsewhere for capability reporting.
to_dict uses asdict which may fail on non-serializable payload values; no custom serialization is applied.
from_dict uses str() on required fields, silently coercing types; if data has missing keys it raises KeyError.
event_to_transport_record uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() for timestamp, which is stable and timezone-aware.
Content construction for SessionStarted and AgentCapabilities falls back to json.dumps(payload); for SessionStarted payload is a dict with session_id.
record_id format is f'{session_id}:{direction}:{sequence:08d}' which is deterministic and unique per session/direction/sequence.
